Join for free right now — no sign-up required! Civilization is a Hard Survival server for Minecraft Bedrock with an in-chat AI assistant. Just type a dot (.) followed by your question, like .how to make a torch — no need to switch screens to search outside the game.

Long-press the line below to copy the Server Address:

minecraft.wasteland7912.uk

Port: 19132

How to join directly in-game:

1. Copy the Server Address above → Open Minecraft (Bedrock on Mobile / Tablet / Windows)

2. Tap Play → Go to the Servers tab

3. Tap Add Server → Paste into Server Address

4. Keep Port 19132 (default) → Tap Join and start playing!

For Minecraft Bedrock on Mobile, Tablet, and Windows only (Not Java Edition) · No Pay-to-Win · Ages 13+
